# TerraSpectra Sample Dataset

## Dataset Overview
Synthetic hyperspectral crop dataset for development and testing.

## Specifications
- Image dimensions: 128 x 128 pixels
- Spectral bands: 224
- Wavelength range: 400-1000 nm
- Data type: Float32
- Formats: HDF5 and GeoTIFF

## Crop Classes
- 0: Healthy
- 1: Disease-stressed

## Generated Files
- hyperspectral_sample.h5
- hyperspectral_sample.tif
- crop_labels.tif

Note: This is synthetic data, not real satellite imagery or scientifically validated crop disease data.
